When the world becomes too loud, the heart begins searching for silence.

*"मौनातला विठ्ठल"* is a meditative devotional journey inspired by the mystical depth of Raag Malkauns and the timeless presence of Lord Vitthal.

This music explores a form of devotion beyond ritual, beyond words, beyond sound itself — where Vitthal is experienced not through the ears, but through the stillness of the heart.
